title.narrative: Program to Support the Consolidation of a Fair, Clean and Sustainable Electricity System II
Programa de Apoyo a la Consolidacin de un Sistema Elctrico Justo, Limpio y Sostenible II

description.narrative: El objetivo general de la serie programtica es apoyar un desarrollo sostenible bajo en emisiones e inclusivo de Panam, a travs de una transicin energtica limpia, justa e inclusiva. Los objetivos especficos de la primera operacin son: (i) fomentar el incremento de la generacin de fuentes renovables variables en la matriz de generacin; (ii) apoyar a incrementar el acceso a electricidad; (iii) fomentar la movilidad elctrica; (iv) apoyar a la reduccin de la brecha de gnero en el sector; y (v) fomentar de la creacin de capacidades en empleo verde para la transicin energtica.

The general objective of the programmatic series is to support a low-emission and inclusive sustainable development of Panama, through a clean, fair and inclusive energy transition. The specific objectives of the first operation are: (i) promote the increase in the generation of variable renewable sources in the generation matrix; (ii) support the increase in access to electricity; (iii) promote electric mobility; (iv) support the reduction of the gender gap in the sector; and (v) promote the creation of green employment capacities for the energy transition.
